spec.assertion: Trigger must be hitCount:80 counting landed PELLETS. Counterfactual re-keys it to count:8 (the rounds reading, hitsPerShot=10); the patched run must fire the buff strictly MORE often than the committed one. RED under a rounds/shots-fired reading or a plain interval trigger.

buffApply stat attackDamagePct value 72, self-targeted, fires >=2 times with durationShots===3. RED under a generic atkPct encoding, a wrong magnitude, or a permanent buff. Inertness: zeroing it lowers only her total; every teammate total is byte-identical (a pure damage multiplier cannot touch gauge).

durationShots===3 on the emitted buffApply, plus a counterfactual that rewrites durationShots:3 -> durationSec:3; total damage must MOVE. RED under the wall-clock reading (ammo 9 + 111f reload means a 3-round window cannot coincide with a 3-second one).

buffApply hitRatePct 98.18 with durationShots===3; zeroing it strictly lowers her total (hitRatePct is the core-hit lift, live by default). RED if the line is dropped or encoded as a generic crit stat.

ACTIVE part: hasPierce must NOT be true (whole-fight tagging would make S2a's +55.08% Pierce Damage live from t=0 for 180s), and a gainPierce effect must sit on a hitCount-triggered block. SKIPPED part: gainPierce has no durationShots, so the round-count window is inexpressible — any durationSec is a ⚑ estimate (recipe: 3 pulls at her measured cadence, + ~1.85s if the window spans a reload).

spec.kitLine: Pellet count is fixed at 1 (3 rounds)
spec.assertion: it.skip. Two blockers: (1) no stat-CLAMP primitive — pelletCountFlat is a flat ADD, so 'fixed at 1' can only be approximated as -9 and then composes wrongly with the burst's +5 (would give 6, not 1); (2) the schema's documented semantics make 1 pellet ≈ 1/10 of a shot, while the kit is SILENT on whether the consolidated pellet carries the full shot payload. Guessing that payload would be a fudge; recipe = popup value of a post-threshold shot vs a pre-threshold shot on footage.

it.skip — no pierce-depth/range primitive in the schema, and the v1 boss is single-target so the payload is unobservable. Paired with an ACTIVE assertion that the line is recorded in `unmodeled` (no silent drop).

buffApply pierceDamagePct 55.08 must appear BEFORE the first fullBurstStart (battle-start passive). Counterfactual is deliberately one-sided (zeroing must not RAISE damage) because the stat only feeds Damage Up while her attacks are Pierce-tagged and may still be v1-inert; an increase would mean an inverted sign.

Application count === fullBurstStart count, and the first application comes AFTER the first fullBurstStart in event order. RED under a passive model (one apply at frame 0) and under a burstCast key (would fire only on HER rotations — the fixture's second B3 makes the two counts differ).

Same trigger identity as the ATK line: count === fullBurstStart count, first apply after the first FB start. Plus a structural bound: both S2b buffs carry durationSec <= 10 so they cannot leak past the Full Burst window.

Ordering discriminator: at each application the nearest preceding burstCast index must exceed the nearest preceding fullBurstStart index — i.e. keyed to her CAST, which precedes FB entry. RED under a fullBurstEnter mis-key (over-credits rotations the other B3 closes). Structural: durationSec===15, not clamped to the 10s FB.

pelletCountFlat 5 (not a normalAttackPct proxy — a different mechanic), same burst-cast ordering, durationSec 15. Zeroing it lowers her total while leaving every teammate byte-identical, pinning the documented gauge-neutrality of extra pellets.

attackSpeedPct 65 is DAMAGE, not a defensive skip: zeroing it must strictly reduce her shots fired. RED if the line is dropped or filed as non-damaging. No teammate-inertness claim here — more shots means more gauge, so the rotation legitimately shifts.

fixtures: controlComp('dorothy-serendipity', true) = liter(B1)/crown(B2)/dorothy-serendipity(B3)/helm(B3), boss Fire, deterministic (no seed). helm is kept ON deliberately rather than dropped: as a SECOND Burst III she makes the burst-cast vs full-burst-enter distinction non-vacuous (dorothy-serendipity does not necessarily cast on every team Full Burst), which is what gives the S2b vs burst trigger-identity assertions their teeth; a lone B3 would produce ZERO Full Bursts and make every burst/FB assertion vacuous. 8 hoisted runs (base + 7 counterfactuals), each a full 180s sim. gaps: skill1 'Pellet count is fixed at 1 for 3 round(s)' — it.skip: no stat-CLAMP primitive (pelletCountFlat is a flat add; -9 composes wrongly with the burst's +5), AND the damage payload of the consolidated single pellet is kit-silent (⚑ measurement-gated; recipe = compare post-threshold vs pre-threshold shot popups).

skill1 'Gains Pierce for 3 round(s)' — it.skip on the window fidelity only: gainPierce accepts durationSec but not durationShots, so a round-count pierce window is inexpressible and any committed seconds value is a ⚑ estimate.
